Record browser

Faceted, client-side browser over all protein-trait records — search by label, identifier, or definition; filter by axis, category, and source. Each record shows semantically related traits from a local text-embedding model.

Three 2-D maps sit alongside it: the corpus map projects a retained subset of record text embeddings (full-record or definition-only), the protein map lays out 68,657 Swiss-Prot proteins by the traits they carry, coloured by domain of life, and the sequence map lays out the canonical-example proteins by their ESM-2 protein-language-model embedding — sequence only, no annotation in the input — coloured by domain of life and filterable by sequence length and, for the half of them that carry one, by CATH class.

Cobalt Element Critical Material

Cobalt (Co), atomic number 27. This element-level record uses the ChEBI cobalt-atom identifier for chemical identity. Cobalt-bearing cathodes and mixed battery black mass are material forms and secondary resources, respectively; neither is a mineral species or synonymous with the element. The dated US designation maps the listed cobalt commodity to this element record; it does not designate every cobalt-bearing mineral or waste stream.

Akaganeite Mineral

Akaganeite is a distinct iron oxyhydroxide mineral species, listed with formula (Fe(III),Ni(II))8(OH,O)16Cl1.25·nH2O, renamed status (Rn), and IMA number 1962-004 in the September 2026 IMA master list. The experimental abbreviation beta-FeOOH identifies the synthetic phase assignment used by the study; it does not establish the ideal IMA composition or nickel content of that preparation. This record is separate from iron element, other iron oxyhydroxide species, iron-ore commodities, and mixed waste feeds. No constituent criticality designation is inherited.
